about: The legislation each election was held under: the Acts, Orders and Rules (legislation.gov.uk) that set its franchise, rules or areas. basis 'direct' means the instrument was made for these elections; 'in force' means it governed them at the time. Keyed by body__date (data/elections-source/data/elections/<body>/<date>). Read by scripts/build-election-provenance.mjs, which lists them on every contest of each election (election-provenance.json, contests[].legislation). Citations only: titles, URLs and Civgraph's own notes.

items.label: Urban District Councillors and Town Commissioners Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1922 (S.R. & O. 1922 No. 71)
items.note: Made 7 Dec 1922 by the Ministry of Home Affairs: applied the Local Government Board's 1898 election rules, as amended, to urban district and town commissioners' elections in Northern Ireland after the abolition of proportional representation, for the elections of January 1923 onwards.

items.label: County and Rural District Councillors Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1924 (S.R. & O. 1924 No. 2)
items.note: The Ministry of Home Affairs' rules for the nomination and election of county and rural district councillors, first used at the county and rural district elections of 29 May 1924 (on the county electoral divisions of December 1923).

items.label: County and Rural District Councillors No. 2 Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1924 (S.R. & O. 1924 No. 36)
items.note: Made 16 Apr 1924, amending the 1924 rules for county and rural district councillors' elections before the elections of 29 May 1924.

items.label: County and Rural District Councillors Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1929 (S.R. & O. 1929 No. 43)
items.note: Made 1 May 1929: amended the forms of oath and affirmation in the 1924 county and rural district election rules (qualification other than a company qualification); in force at the next county and rural elections, 29 May 1930.

items.label: Urban District Councillors and Town Commissioners Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1929 (S.R. & O. 1929 No. 45)
items.note: Made 1 May 1929: amended the forms of oath and affirmation in the urban district election rules; in force at the next urban district election held on the site, Lurgan's of 15 Jan 1930.

items.label: County and Rural District Councillors Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1930 (S.R. & O. 1930 No. 81)
items.note: Made 17 Jun 1930: revoked section 24 of the Ballot Act 1872 (personation) as set out in the 1924 county and rural district election rules; in force at the next county and rural elections, 25 May 1933.

items.label: Urban District Councillors and Town Commissioners Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1930 (S.R. & O. 1930 No. 84)
items.note: Made 17 Jun 1930: revoked section 24 of the Ballot Act 1872 (personation) as set out in the urban district election rules; in force at Lurgan's election of 15 Jan 1931.

items.label: County and Rural District Councillors Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1931 (S.R. & O. 1931 No. 12)
items.note: Made 11 Feb 1931: amended Rule 50 of the Ballot Act rules (acts a presiding officer may do by his clerks) for county and rural district elections; in force at the elections of 25 May 1933.

items.label: Urban District Councillors and Town Commissioners Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1931 (S.R. & O. 1931 No. 14)
items.note: Made 11 Feb 1931: amended Rule 50 of the Ballot Act rules (acts a presiding officer may do by his clerks) for urban district elections; in force at the urban district elections of 15 Jan 1932.

items.label: Urban District Councillors and Town Commissioners Election Order (Northern Ireland) 1936 (S.R. & O. 1936 No. 35)
items.note: Made 6 Apr 1936: adapted the urban district election timetable to the new ordinary day of election, 15 May, fixed by section 10 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1934, for the elections of 15 May 1936.

items.label: Local Government (Postponement of Elections) Order (Northern Ireland) 1937 (S.R. & O. 1937 No. 70)
items.note: Order in Council under the Local Government (Postponement of Elections) Act (Northern Ireland) 1937: for 1937 the ordinary day of election of borough and urban district councillors and town commissioners was postponed from 15 May to 15 Oct 1937 (Belfast Gazette, issue 842, 13 Aug 1937).

items.label: Local Government (Elections) Order (Northern Ireland) 1937 (S.R. & O. 1937 No. 71)
items.note: Made 30 Aug 1937: the timetable for the postponed 1937 borough and urban district elections (notice of election by 1 Oct, nominations by 5 Oct, day of election 15 Oct 1937).

items.label: Electoral (Election of Urban District Councillors and Town Commissioners) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1946 (S.R. & O. 1946 No. 116)
items.note: Made 6 Aug 1946 under the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946: adapted the urban district election rules to that Act for the first post-war urban elections, September 1946.

items.label: Electoral (Election of County and Rural District Councillors) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1946 (S.R. & O. 1946 No. 117)
items.note: Made 7 Aug 1946 under the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946: amended the 1924 county and rural district election rules for the first post-war county and rural elections, 3 Oct 1946.

items.label: Electoral (Returning Officer's Certificate) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1946 (S.R. & O. 1946 No. 129)
items.note: Made 30 Aug 1946: the form of the returning officer's certificate at any local government election under section 23(7) of the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946, in force for the September and October 1946 local elections.

items.label: Electoral (Local Government Elections) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1949 (S.R. & O. 1949 No. 18)
items.note: In force 1 Apr 1949: rules for the conduct of all ordinary local government elections (and casual-vacancy elections in county boroughs and boroughs) under the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946, first used at the 1949 local elections.

items.label: Electoral (Local Government Elections) (No. 2) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1952 (S.R. & O. 1952 No. 60)
items.note: Made 28 Apr 1952, in force 1 May 1952: revoked the earlier 1952 local election regulations and amended the 1949 rules on the documents of identity a voter could be asked to produce, for the 1952 local elections.

items.label: Electoral (Local Government Elections) (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1955 (S.R. & O. 1955 No. 53)
items.note: In operation 1 May 1955: amended the local election rules before the 1955 local elections.

items.label: Electoral (Parliamentary and Local Government Elections) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1953 (S.R. & O. 1953 No. 126)
items.note: Made 1 Oct 1953, in force forthwith, under the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946 as amended by the Electoral Law Amendment Act (Northern Ireland) 1953: in force for the general election of 22 Oct 1953 and the 1955 local elections.

items.label: Electoral Law (Local Elections) (Forms) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1962 (S.R. & O. 1962 No. 122)
items.note: Made 6 Jul 1962 under section 127 of and Schedule 5 to the Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962: the forms for local elections, first used at the 1964 local elections.

items.label: Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 (1962 c. 14)
items.note: Royal Assent 29 Mar 1962; mostly in operation 1 May 1962. Consolidated with amendments the law on parliamentary and local government elections, corrupt and illegal practices and election petitions: the governing Act for the Stormont general elections of 1962, 1965 and 1969 and the local elections of 1964 and 1967.

items.label: Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 (Commencement No. 1) Order (Northern Ireland) 1962 (S.R. & O. 1962 No. 83)
items.note: Made 1 May 1962: brought the Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962, except some repeals, into operation on 1 May 1962, a month before the general election of 31 May 1962.

items.label: Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1969 (1969 c. 26)
items.note: Royal Assent 25 Nov 1969. Extended the local government franchise to all parliamentary electors (ending the ratepayer franchise), lowered the voting age to 18 and postponed the triennial local elections; the 1973 district council elections were the first local elections held on this franchise.

items.label: Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1971 (1971 c. 4)
items.note: Royal Assent 25 Feb 1971. Advanced the date of the extended local government franchise, provided for annual registers and further postponed the triennial local elections, which next took place on 30 May 1973 for the new district councils.

items.label: Local Government (Postponement of Elections and Reorganisation) (Northern Ireland) Order 1972 (S.I. 1972 No. 1998 (N.I. 21))
items.note: Made 20 Dec 1972. Postponed the local elections and amended section 11 of the Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 and Articles 3 and 4 of the Electoral Law (Northern Ireland) Order 1972 (the special provisions for the 1973 local general elections), in preparation for the first elections to the 26 district councils.

items.label: Electoral Law (Northern Ireland) Order 1972 (S.I. 1972 No. 1264 (N.I. 13))
items.note: Made 14 Aug 1972. Article 4 made special provision for the local general elections to be held in 1973, by single transferable vote in district electoral areas, with the Chief Electoral Officer as returning officer.

items.label: Electoral Law (Northern Ireland) Order 1973 (S.I. 1973 No. 740)
items.note: Made 13 Apr 1973, in operation 14 Apr 1973. Article 3 provided for postal voting at the 1973 local general election (exercised by the Electoral Law (Local General Election 1973 Postal Voting) Regulations).

items.label: Electoral Law (Local General Election 1973) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1973 (S.R. & O. 1973 No. 122)
items.note: Made 16 Apr 1973 under Article 4(12) of the Electoral Law (Northern Ireland) Order 1972: the rules for the conduct of the local general election of 30 May 1973.

items.label: Electoral Law (Local General Election 1973 Postal Voting) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1973 (S.R. & O. 1973 No. 127)
items.note: Made 18 Apr 1973 under Article 3 of the Electoral Law (Northern Ireland) Order 1973: postal voting at the 1973 local general election (applications by 10 and 17 May 1973).

items.label: Electoral Law (Local General Election 1973) (No. 2) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1973 (S.R. & O. 1973 No. 173)
items.note: Made 4 Jun 1973: where a candidate's death caused a fresh election in a district electoral area after the 1973 local general elections, the Ministry of Development was to direct when that council's annual meeting was held.

items.label: Electoral Law (Casual Vacancies in District Councils) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1974 (S.R. 1974 No. 156)
items.note: In operation 18 Jun 1974: a casual vacancy in a district council is filled by the council's unopposed choice, failing which by a by-election in the district electoral area under the 1973 election rules; in force at the Belfast Area E by-election of 9 Dec 1981.

items.label: Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 (Amendment) Order 2005 (S.I. 2005 No. 862)
items.note: Made 22 Mar 2005, in force the next day: moved the day of local elections from the third Wednesday in May to the first Thursday in May, so the 2005 local elections were held on 5 May 2005 with the Westminster general election.

items.label: Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 (Amendment No. 2) Order 2005 (S.I. 2005 No. 863)
items.note: Made 22 Mar 2005, in force the next day: admitted Electoral Commissioners and Commission staff to polling stations at local elections (rule 29(1), Schedule 5), in force for the local elections of 5 May 2005.

items.label: Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 (Amendment No. 3) Order 2005 (S.I. 2005 No. 864)
items.note: Made 22 Mar 2005, in force the next day: raised the limit of a local election candidate's expenses (section 42(1)) to £600 plus 5p per elector, in force for the local elections of 5 May 2005.

items.label: Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 (Amendment) Order 2010 (S.I. 2010 No. 1178)
items.note: Made 31 Mar 2010: casual vacancies in district councils arising from the next day are filled by the nominating officer of the former member's party (sections 11D-11K), an election being held only where no one is so returned; in force for later district council by-elections.

items.label: Parliamentary Elections, Returning Officers' Expenses (Bye-Elections) Order (Northern Ireland) 1924 (S.R. & O. 1924 No. 63)
items.note: Ministry of Finance scale of returning officers' charges for elections to the Parliament of Northern Ireland other than elections of the full number of members (by-elections), for elections after its date in 1924; revoked in April 1929. In force at the by-elections of November 1925.

items.label: Parliamentary Elections, Returning Officers' Expenses (Northern Ireland) 1925 (S.R. & O. 1925 No. 24)
items.note: Made 12 Mar 1925: the scale of returning officers' charges for general elections to the House of Commons of Northern Ireland, for the general election of 3 Apr 1925.

items.label: Parliamentary Elections, Returning Officers' Expenses (No. 2) Order (Northern Ireland) 1925 (S.R. & O. 1925 No. 89)
items.note: Made 25 Mar 1925: amended the general-election scale of 12 Mar 1925 (sorters and counters where candidates exceed seats), for the general election of 3 Apr 1925.

items.label: Parliamentary Elections: Returning Officers' Charges Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1929 (S.R. & O. 1929 No. 40)
items.note: Made 26 Apr 1929: a new scale of returning officers' charges for elections to the House of Commons of Northern Ireland, revoking the 1921-1925 scales, for the first general election on the single-member constituencies of 1929 (22 May 1929).

items.label: University Elections (Single Transferable Vote) Amendment Order (Northern Ireland) 1929 (S.R. & O. 1929 No. 49)
items.note: Order in Council of 7 May 1929, under section 6 of the House of Commons (Method of Voting and Redistribution of Seats) Act (Northern Ireland) 1929: amended the single transferable vote regulations for the Queen's University of Belfast constituency, which kept proportional representation, for its contest at the general election of 22 May 1929.

items.label: Parliamentary Elections: Returning Officers' Charges Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1931 (S.R. & O. 1931 No. 19)
items.note: Scale of returning officers' charges for elections in the territorial constituencies of the House of Commons (Method of Voting and Redistribution of Seats) Act (Northern Ireland) 1929, applicable to elections after 30 Apr 1929; in force at the general election of 30 Nov 1933.

items.label: Parliamentary Elections (Returning Officers' Charges) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1945 (S.R. & O. 1945 No. 58)
items.note: Made 24 May 1945: the scale of returning officers' charges for elections to the House of Commons of Northern Ireland, three weeks before the general election of 14 Jun 1945.

items.label: Parliamentary Elections (Returning Officers' Charges) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1945 (S.R. & O. 1945 No. 67)
items.note: Made 6 Jun 1945: varied the application of the scale of 24 May 1945 to elections held before a stated date, for the general election of 14 Jun 1945.

items.label: Parliamentary Elections (Returning Officers Charges) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1946 (S.R. & O. 1946 No. 6)
items.note: Made 14 Jan 1946: further varied the application of the 1945 scale of returning officers' charges (constituencies other than the university); in force at the Belfast Central by-election of 22 Aug 1946.

items.label: Electoral (University Register and Elections) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1946 (S.R. & O. 1946 No. 89)
items.note: Made 21 Jun 1946 under the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946: the register and conduct of elections for the Queen's University constituency, in force for its contest at the general election of 10 Feb 1949.

items.label: Electoral (Parliamentary Elections) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1946 (S.R. & O. 1946 No. 136)
items.note: Made 4 Sep 1946 under sections 20, 26 and 54 of the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946: questions and oaths at the poll, postal voting and related rules for parliamentary elections, in force at the general election of 10 Feb 1949.

items.label: Electoral (Parliamentary Returning Officers' Charges) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1946 (S.R. & O. 1946 No. 229)
items.note: Made 28 Sep 1946 under section 40 of the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946: returning officers' charges at elections to the House of Commons of Northern Ireland (other than the university), in force at the general elections of 1949 and 1953.

items.label: Electoral (Parliamentary Elections) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1952 (S.R. & O. 1952 No. 24)
items.note: Made 3 Mar 1952 under section 54 of the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946: amended the parliamentary election rules of 1946; in force at the general election of 22 Oct 1953.

items.label: Electoral (Parliamentary Returning Officers' Charges) (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1956 (S.R. & O. 1956 No. 173)
items.note: In operation 16 Nov 1956: amended the scale of parliamentary returning officers' charges; in force at the Belfast Windsor and Belfast Duncairn by-elections of 23 Nov and 4 Dec 1956.

items.label: Electoral (Parliamentary Returning Officers' Charges) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1957 (S.R. & O. 1957 No. 263)
items.note: Made late in 1957 under sections 40 and 54 of the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946: a new scale of returning officers' fees and charges, in force at the general election of 20 Mar 1958.

items.label: Electoral Law (Parliamentary Elections) (Forms) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1962 (S.R. & O. 1962 No. 84)
items.note: Made 2 May 1962 under section 127 of and the Fourth and Seventh Schedules to the Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962: the forms for parliamentary elections, for the general election of 31 May 1962.

items.label: Electoral Law (Parliamentary Elections) (University Constituency) (Forms) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1962 (S.R. & O. 1962 No. 87)
items.note: Made 7 May 1962 under the Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962: the forms for elections in the Queen's University constituency, for its contest at the general election of 31 May 1962.

items.label: Electoral Law (Returning Officers' Remuneration and Expenses) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1962 (S.R. & O. 1962 No. 89)
items.note: Made and in operation 9 May 1962 under sections 22 and 127 of the Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962: returning officers' remuneration and expenses at parliamentary elections, for the general election of 31 May 1962.

items.label: Electoral Law (Returning Officers' Remuneration and Expenses) (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1970 (S.R. & O. 1970 No. 8)
items.note: Made 15 Jan 1970: amended the 1962 scale of returning officers' remuneration and expenses, having effect only for the purposes of the general election of 24 Feb 1969.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Election) Order 1973 (S.I. 1973 No. 890)
items.note: Made 9 May 1973, in operation 15 May 1973, under the Northern Ireland Assembly Act 1973; applies only to the first election to the Assembly, applying the Electoral Law Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 to it.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Bye-Elections) Order 1974 (S.I. 1974 No. 545)
items.note: Made 25 Mar 1974, in operation 24 Apr 1974: the procedure for by-elections to fill casual vacancies in the 1973 Assembly, under which the North Antrim by-election of 20 Jun 1974 was held.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Day of Election) Order 1982 (S.I. 1982 No. 1078)
items.note: Made 30 Jul 1982, in operation forthwith: appointed 20 Oct 1982 as the day of election of members to a new Northern Ireland Assembly.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly Elections Order 1982 (S.I. 1982 No. 1135)
items.note: Made 5 Aug 1982, in operation 6 Sep 1982: the rules for Assembly general elections and by-elections, for the election of 20 Oct 1982 and the by-elections of 1983-85.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly Election Petition Rules 1982 (S.R. 1982 No. 307)
items.note: Made 23 Sep 1982, in force on polling day, 20 Oct 1982: the rules for petitions questioning an Assembly election or return under the Northern Ireland Assembly Elections Order 1982.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly Elections (Amendment) Order 1985 (S.I. 1985 No. 1268)
items.note: Made 8 Aug 1985, in operation 17 Sep 1985: added offences of possessing specified documents with intent to personate (new Article 7A of the 1982 Order), in force at the South Down by-election of 17 Oct 1985.

items.label: New Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) Order 1998 (S.I. 1998 No. 1287)
items.note: Made 21 May 1998 under the Northern Ireland (Elections) Act 1998: the rules for the election to the New Northern Ireland Assembly of 25 Jun 1998.

items.label: New Northern Ireland Assembly Elections (Returning Officer's Charges) Order 1998 (S.I. 1998 No. 1493)
items.note: Made 16 Jun 1998, in force 17 Jun 1998: the returning officer's maximum recoverable charges for the Assembly election of 25 Jun 1998.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) Order 2001 (S.I. 2001 No. 2599)
items.note: Made 18 Jul 2001, in force 1 Aug 2001, under sections 34(4) and 35(1) of the Northern Ireland Act 1998, revoking the 1998 Order: the principal rules for Assembly elections from 2003.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) (Amendment) Order 2002 (S.I. 2002 No. 1964)
items.note: Made 24 Jul 2002, in force 1 Dec 2002: amended Schedule 1 to the 2001 Order (statutory provisions applied to Assembly elections), in force at the Assembly election of 26 Nov 2003.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) (Amendment) Order 2003 (S.I. 2003 No. 2989)
items.note: Made 12 Nov 2003, in force the next day, two weeks before the Assembly election of 26 Nov 2003: amended the rules applied to Assembly elections (including admission to polling stations).

items.label: New Northern Ireland Assembly Elections (Returning Officer's Charges) (Amendment) Order 2003 (S.I. 2003 No. 3029)
items.note: Made 19 Nov 2003, in force the next day: raised the returning officer's maximum recoverable amounts for the Assembly election of 26 Nov 2003.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) (Amendment) Order 2007 (S.I. 2007 No. 308)
items.note: Made 6 Feb 2007, in force the next day: amended the election-expenses provisions applied by the 2001 Order, a month before the Assembly election of 7 Mar 2007.

items.label: New Northern Ireland Assembly Elections (Returning Officer's Charges) (Amendment) Order 2007 (S.I. 2007 No. 644)
items.note: Made 28 Feb 2007, in force 1 Mar 2007: amended the returning officer's maximum recoverable amounts for the Assembly election of 7 Mar 2007.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) (Amendment) Order 2009 (S.I. 2009 No. 256)
items.note: Made 9 Feb 2009, in force the next day: substituted Article 3 of the 2001 Order (provisions applied to Assembly elections, including the Representation of the People (Northern Ireland) Regulations 2008); in force at the Assembly election of 5 May 2011.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) (Amendment) Order 2010 (S.I. 2010 No. 2892)
items.note: Made 1 Dec 2010, in force the next day: a new Article 8 of the 2001 Order for the Chief Electoral Officer to hold an election to fill seats left unfilled at an Assembly election; in force at the election of 5 May 2011.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly Elections (Returning Officer's Charges) Order 2011 (S.I. 2011 No. 473)
items.note: Made 19 Feb 2011: the overall maximum recoverable amount for each constituency at Assembly elections, for the election of 5 May 2011; revoked 23 Mar 2016.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) (Amendment) Order 2014 (S.I. 2014 No. 1804)
items.note: Made 9 Jul 2014, in force 15 Sep 2014: anonymous registration for Assembly elections; in force at the Assembly election of 5 May 2016.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) (Forms) Order 2015 (S.I. 2015 No. 222)
items.note: Made 11 Feb 2015, in force the next day: the forms for Assembly elections, in force at the election of 5 May 2016.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) (Amendment) Order 2015 (S.I. 2015 No. 1610)
items.note: Made 29 Jul 2015, in force the next day: polling districts and polling places for Assembly elections, needed because the local ones were redrawn with the 2015 districts; in force at the election of 5 May 2016.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly Elections (Returning Officer's Charges) Order 2016 (S.I. 2016 No. 473)
items.note: Made 22 Mar 2016: the overall maximum recoverable amount for each constituency at Assembly elections, for the elections of 5 May 2016 and 2 Mar 2017; revoked 23 Mar 2022.

items.label: Northern Ireland Assembly Elections (Returning Officer's Charges) Order 2022 (S.I. 2022 No. 373)
items.note: Made 22 Mar 2022, in force the next day: the overall maximum recoverable amount for each constituency, for the Assembly election of 5 May 2022.

items.label: European Assembly Elections (Northern Ireland) Regulations 1979 (S.I. 1979 No. 322)
items.note: Made 15 Mar 1979, in operation 29 Mar 1979, under the European Assembly Elections Act 1978: the conduct of the first direct election in the Northern Ireland three-member STV constituency, 7 Jun 1979.

items.label: European Assembly Elections (Returning Officers' Expenses) (Northern Ireland) Regulations 1979 (S.I. 1979 No. 589)
items.note: Made 23 May 1979, in operation 28 May 1979: the Chief Electoral Officer's maximum charges as returning officer for the European Assembly election of 7 Jun 1979.

items.label: European Assembly Election Petition Rules (Northern Ireland) 1979 (S.R. 1979 No. 179)
items.note: Made 17 May 1979, in operation on polling day, 7 Jun 1979: the rules for petitions questioning the European Assembly election in Northern Ireland.

items.label: European Assembly Elections (Northern Ireland) Regulations 1984 (S.I. 1984 No. 198)
items.note: Made 22 Feb 1984, in operation 7 Mar 1984: the conduct of the European Assembly election in Northern Ireland of 14 Jun 1984, applying the Representation of the People Act 1983.

items.label: European Assembly Elections (Returning Officers' Expenses) (Northern Ireland) Regulations 1984 (S.I. 1984 No. 724)
items.note: Made 22 May 1984, in operation 23 May 1984: the Chief Electoral Officer's maximum charges as returning officer for the European Assembly election of 14 Jun 1984.

items.label: European Assembly Election Petition Rules (Northern Ireland) 1984 (S.R. 1984 No. 162)
items.note: Made 14 May 1984, in operation 13 Jun 1984, the day before the poll: the rules for petitions questioning the European Assembly election in Northern Ireland.

items.label: European Assembly Elections (Northern Ireland) Regulations 1986 (S.I. 1986 No. 2250)
items.note: Made 16 Dec 1986: replaced the 1984 Regulations for the conduct of European Assembly elections in Northern Ireland; in force at the next election, 15 Jun 1989.
